code_rights.question: Can anyone legally copy, modify, sell and fork the original work? Are licences and dependencies documented?

disclaimer: Automated scan of public files at one commit. Finding a file shows that it exists, not that it is correct or followed. Not finding one shows only that it isn't in this repository; the evidence may live elsewhere. Nothing here is independently verified, and JRCv1 is a draft standard, not a certification.
